name: Northern Star
description: Perfect for the master bath suite, in-home exercise area or in some other private retreat, this diminutive sauna is loaded with luxury. Its European design includes a dramatic curved glass door, integral shelving, and low-voltage lighting inside and out. Available in three sizes. Exterior dimensions 5' x 5', 6’ x 6’, or 7' x 7', plus 6” overhang. Includes Fonda or Pikkutontu or Saunatonttu, sauna heater, rocks, bucket, ladle and thermometer.
